toast.typeInUse: Still referenced by {{count}} component(s) — reclassify them first

matching.title: Component Type Matching Rules
matching.noEntries: No {{kind}} entries. No matching rules are added automatically.
matching.caseSensitiveHint: Case-sensitive (ASCII case folding only when off)
matching.reportHint: Revision {{revision}}. The total includes protected, classified components; matches and eligible updates are counted separately. Up to 100 details are shown; counts cover every scanned component.
matching.scope: Rules apply to every component library, regardless of sidebar filters. Applying only fills empty types / Unknown; classified components keep their types.
matching.orderHint: Exact exceptions → highest-priority regex → Unknown. Equal-priority matches for different types remain unclassified and report a conflict. Model reads MPN; Reference is read only when the field exists.
matching.engineHint: PCRE2 8-bit matches bytes with UTF/UCP off; case-insensitive matching folds ASCII only. Patterns are limited to {{pattern}} bytes and source fields to {{source}} bytes. Exceeding the matching work limit reports a limit error, rather than an unmatched result.

barrier.rejected: The request was rejected. Your draft is preserved. Reload the configuration and check its revision before retrying.
barrier.save: The configuration was saved but has not been confirmed by a read. Retry reading; there is no need to save again.
barrier.applied: This operation has finished. To save a draft or process newly unclassified components, click “Reload configuration” to check the state before starting another operation.

matching.unhealthy: The saved configuration has not loaded successfully. Saving, database preview and applying are disabled. A snapshot draft can still be used for sample diagnostics.
matching.sampleHint: Check a field to provide it; an empty checked input sends an explicit empty string. Unchecked fields are omitted. Leaving every field unchecked still previews a sample.
matching.actionHint: Preview does not write to the database. Saving only saves rules; applying uses the saved revision. Applying is blocked while the draft is unsaved, the revision needs checking or the result is unknown.
matching.previewing: Previewing… You can edit the inputs and preview again.

refresh.superseded: This read was superseded by a newer request

notices.changedUnderDraft: The saved revision changed. Your draft is preserved. Reload and check before saving.
notices.saved: Configuration saved. You can preview it before applying to unclassified components.
notices.reloadedDraft: Configuration reloaded. Your draft is preserved. Check it before saving.
notices.synchronized: Apply results are synchronized across components, statistics, libraries, issues and types.
notices.refreshRequired: Writing has finished, but the views are not yet synchronized. Retry refreshing; there is no need to apply again.
notices.refreshFailed: Writing has finished, but refreshing failed. Retry refreshing.
notices.saveUnknown: The save result is unknown. Reload and check the configuration before continuing.
notices.applyUnknown: The apply result is unknown. Reload the configuration, refresh the views and check the results before continuing.
notices.recovered: Reading and refreshing have finished. Click “Reload configuration” once more to check the state, then explicitly start a new save or apply operation.
notices.savingRead: Configuration saved as revision {{revision}}. Reading it back…
notices.appliedRefreshing: Writing finished: {{count}} components updated. Refreshing views…
